short_summary: Cape Town CBD: added 5 new businesses on Long/Bree Street (Mama Africa, Royale Eatery, Clarke's Bar and Dining Room, Barr's Pharmacy, Clarke's Bookshop), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Added Golden Acre shopping centre (9 Adderley Street) but deferred tenant discovery to job 3's official-site sweep, queued via shopping_center_slugs_pending. Discarded a gym lead (Zone Fitness/Virgin Active) where sources conflicted on which brand occupies the address.

Gardens: added 3 new businesses on Kloof Street/Queen Victoria Street (Kloof Street House, Our Local, Cape Town Hollow Boutique Hotel), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Added Gardens Shopping Centre (cnr Mill and Buitenkant Streets) but deferred tenant discovery to job 3's official-site sweep. Discarded a dental-practice lead (Gardens Dental Surgery / The Dental Clinic) where only one source confirmed a phone number and the tenant name was ambiguous between similarly-named practices.

Tamboerskloof: added 3 new businesses (Cafe Puka, Dinkel Bakery, The Cape Milner hotel), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. No shopping centres found in this mostly-residential suburb. Noted a couple of near-miss leads that turned out to belong to neighbouring suburbs (Red Sofa Cafe is in Vredehoek, not Tamboerskloof) and left them for those suburbs' own future runs.

Checked the first 5 businesses alphabetically (barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd through kloof-street-house-gardens, all published earlier this same run) -- all still open on current sources, none confirmed permanently closed. Note: Clarke's Bar and Dining Room had a temporary closure announced in 2024 but recent August 2026 reviews confirm it has reopened, so left untouched. closed_check_last_slug now 'kloof-street-house-gardens'.

Rewrote 10 descriptions (of 11 in the whole backlog) with genuine new facts found via research, covering Barr's Pharmacy, Cafe Puka, Cape Town Hollow Boutique Hotel, Clarke's Bar and Dining Room, Clarke's Bookshop, Dinkel Bakery, Kloof Street House, Mama Africa, Our Local and Royale Eatery. Added a new source for 9 of them; Kloof Street House's new facts came from a source already on file, so nothing new to append there. Trading hours found and recorded for 7 of the 10; skipped for Cape Town Hollow (hotel, no published trading hours) and for Dinkel Bakery and Kloof Street House (sources gave conflicting times).

Rewrote the last remaining backlog description, The Cape Milner (57-room boutique hotel, Art Deco/Victorian design, renovated 2014), added a new source. No trading hours applicable (hotel). Description-enrichment backlog is now fully cleared.

Golden Acre has a real official site (golden-acre.co.za/stores/) but it's blocked by this sandbox's egress proxy, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced roughly 40 of its ~105 stores -- not the complete directory, so no reconciliation was attempted (a partial list would risk wrongly unlinking real tenants). Also found the centre is mid-redevelopment (sold Feb 2025, construction from Oct 2025, completion ~Jan 2027) though shopper access is said to continue throughout. Removed from shopping_center_slugs_pending; will get its first re-check via the normal 30-run recheck rotation.

Oranjezicht: added Ou Meul Bakery (cnr Montrose & Upper Orange Street) and Molteno Road Dental Practice (12 Molteno Road), both with verified phone numbers and addresses. Discarded Will's Cafe-Deli (no phone number found in any source) and two guesthouses, Orange Guest House and Floreal House (phone numbers only appeared in unverifiable AI-summarised search results, not literally in any source snippet). Also found that the well-known 'Oranjezicht City Farm Market' actually operates from the V&A Waterfront, not Oranjezicht itself, despite the name -- left for that suburb's own future run. No shopping centres found in this mostly residential suburb.

Vredehoek: added Red Sofa Cafe (21 Derry Street), Deer Park Cafe (2 Deer Park Drive) and KwikSpar Vredehoek (37 Derry Street), all with verified phone numbers and addresses. Discarded a lead for Lazari cafe, where sources disagreed on whether it's actually in Vredehoek or in neighbouring Gardens -- left for whichever suburb's future run resolves the ambiguity. No shopping centres found in this suburb.

Zonnebloem: added Digitas Liquorice and Arc, two marketing/creative agencies both based at The Harrington, 50 Harrington Street. A mostly institutional/residential suburb with little else surfacing -- notably, several well-known 'Zonnebloem'-named schools (Zonnebloem Nest Senior School, Zonnebloem Boys/Girls Primary) turned out to have their actual addresses in neighbouring Walmer Estate, so were left for that suburb's own future run rather than published here. No shopping centres found.

Checked the next 5 businesses after 'kloof-street-house-gardens' (mama-africa-cape-town-cbd, our-local-gardens, royale-eatery-cape-town-cbd, the-cape-milner-tamboerskloof, wrapping to barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd) -- all still open on current sources, none confirmed permanently closed. Noted Royale Eatery had a 2020 pandemic-era relocation to Claremont reported, but current sources (2026) describe an active Long Street listing with current hours, so left untouched absent an explicit closure tag. closed_check_last_slug now 'barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd'.

Cleared the entire job-4 backlog: rewrote descriptions for Arc and Digitas Liquorice (both agencies at The Harrington, Zonnebloem), Deer Park Cafe and Red Sofa Cafe (Vredehoek), KwikSpar Vredehoek, Ou Meul Bakery (Oranjezicht) and Molteno Road Dental Practice (Oranjezicht). All 7 got genuine new facts via WebSearch (WebFetch still blocked for these domains) with a new source appended for KwikSpar, Molteno Road Dental Practice, Deer Park Cafe and Red Sofa Cafe. Trading hours recorded for 5 of the 7 (the two agencies have no public trading hours).

Gardens Shopping Centre has a real official site (gardensshoppingcentre.co.za) with its own store-directory page, but the domain is blocked by this sandbox's egress proxy, and WebSearch snippets only surfaced 3 of the centre's ~86 stores (PostNet, Cape Union Mart, Clicks) -- nowhere near a complete list, so no reconciliation was attempted. Removed from shopping_center_slugs_pending; will get its first re-check via the normal 30-run recheck rotation like Golden Acre.

Discarded La Bottega (address only said 'Cape Town', not confirmed as Woodstock), Karoo Moon Country Store (three conflicting phone numbers across sources, couldn't confidently pin one), and several other Old Biscuit Mill boutique tenants for lack of a findable phone number -- left the mill's full tenant list for job 3's upcoming official-site sweep.

Discarded OBZ Cafe (three different, conflicting phone numbers across sources -- couldn't confidently pin one to this location) and The Image & Hair salon (address and phone got mixed up with a different Lower Main Road business across sources).

Discarded Transnet Engineering's head office (three conflicting phone numbers across sources for what should be one main line), Salt River Pharmacy (two different addresses given across sources), and the Freestyle and Zara factory shops (no phone number found for either). Also noted Salt Circle Arcade at 374 Albert Road as a real multi-tenant arcade, but most sources place it in neighbouring Woodstock rather than Salt River -- left it out of this suburb's batch pending clearer suburb attribution on a future run.

Checked the 5 businesses after 'barrs-pharmacy-cape-town-cbd' (cafe-puka-tamboerskloof, cape-town-hollow-boutique-hotel-gardens, clarkes-bar-dining-room-cape-town-cbd, clarkes-bookshop-cape-town-cbd, deer-park-cafe-vredehoek) -- none confirmed permanently closed. Clarke's Bar and Dining Room had news of a 2020/2024 temporary closure amid tough trading conditions, but no explicit current 'permanently closed' status was found, so left untouched. closed_check_last_slug now 'deer-park-cafe-vredehoek'.

Rewrote 10 descriptions -- 7 with new facts found via research (Artappel Prop Hire, Barksole Riverlands, Cape of Storms Distilling Company, Casa Woodstock Bar, Cocoa Cha Chi, Dimensions Tent & Structures, GoGo Woodstock), 3 reworded from existing category/suburb data only (BUCO Salt River, Clicks Riverlands, District Cafe).
